comment: Take her! One of the nicest professors I've ever had!
Great teacher. Assignments are open ended. You have to be creative and thoughtful to get a good grade. Worth taking if you do not mind putting in a lot of work.

Teacher isn't entirely clear what she wants out of projects. Difficult grader considering the amount of work that goes into each sculpture, especially considering the course is supposed to require no experience.
Took her for beginning sculpture, the assignments are not impossible by any means and she's a nice grader.
LOVE HER SHE IS SO NICE :] such a chill class

fiona is awesome. she has a lot of energy and as long as you put effort into the work you will get a good grade. if you have to get rid of your visual arts gen ed, take this class. kind of hard/frustrating for the first 4 weeks but the rest is easy. you'll have fun
WORST person ever. she should be teaching kindergarten!
Fiona was really nice and interested in our work. sometimes unclear about grading, but effort is important! We read weird books but overall the class was great!
Pretty easy class. Nice lady, but stay on her good side. Not hard to do: just finish projects on time and don't come to class late.
two weeks notice is MORE than enough time to finish a 100 word essay.

best teacher in teh art department but don't take this class if you're looking for an easy A. I think some of the people giving her****ty ratings may have been looking for that and were bummed out when they didn't get it.
good teacher and makes her classes fun....grades like a teacher should...by effort...not whether you are monet

She is very unclear about what she wants, and changes the syllabus constantly to her own needs, without asking if the class agrees. The things we did were extremely simple and boring, and honestly I doubt she can be considered a real artist, she teaches the stupidest techniques. Stupid class, easy.

Excellent.  Exposes students to a lot of varied artists.  Assigns interesting projects.  Doesn't grade hard.  In other words, if you actually put in time, you'll get a good grade.  You put in 5 minutes, you'll probably still not fail, but it won't be pretty.
an excellent teacher and artist. Worked hard to get us to think outside the box. Those who had difficulty didn't want to go the extra mile to make the grade.

Very energetic teacher.  Loves her work.  She accepts anything you can give a good explanation for on how it relates to art.  Go to class.  Write the few 100 word papers.  Act like you care about a project and you will get an A+.  Kindness is rewarded!!!!!

Treats you like a first-grader... assigned us a research paper in half a sentence in an email (2 weeks before due)... tries to give you "ideas" and "help" with your work which are just really unfeasible and unrealistic plans that won't ever work in an intro class. but, a nice woman and good class.
